description: Per-product agent docs bundles built by scripts/unified/mkbundle.py (DESIGN.md section 5.2 item 4). Source roots are absolute under $AFBENCH_MAIN_ROOT or system paths; include/exclude are pathlib full_match globs relative to the root (or zip member names). Redactions remove an exact 1-based inclusive line range after the source's pre_sha256 matches, and must produce post_sha256. Omissions are selected-out files recorded with their source SHA-256 (Q9). files is the expected SHA-256 of every output file; any other, missing or differing file fails. Every output must be free of forbidden_regex. Both agent sets receive identical bundles.
